summary: Automatic project-file discovery for undocumented, source-only, mixed, metadata-only and documentation-only folders. Explicit standalone Core profile fixtures and the adoption planner have separate selection rules.
applicability: The installed service and the discover command use the same bounded project-file inventory with project .gitignore files and optional root .shinignore overrides. Register a folder and its agents to use it through MCP. The standalone planner, language profiles and explicit marker checks below are Core developer tools.
goal: Discover eligible project text and describe its scope without modifying the selected folder.

architectureBoundary.reason: Bootstrap profiles reuse bounded language declaration extraction and point agents to primary source files; Shin is not a compiler, type checker, LSP, or full call-graph engine.
architectureBoundary.sourceAuthority: Generated context is retrieval evidence. Source documents, code, tests, and accepted decisions remain authoritative.

discoveryContract.gitSelection: Apply project-local .gitignore files to eligible paths independently of Git tracking. The root .shinignore takes precedence and can exclude paths or re-include an eligible path with !. Kit safety and resource limits apply to both.
discoveryContract.selection: When at least one eligible regular text file is selected, recommended_profiles contains only generic-source, bootstrap.primary_profile is generic-source and bootstrap.next_steps contains shin-ce init. This includes unfamiliar suffixes, extensionless files, build metadata, mixed repositories, Retool exports and documentation-only folders. Language and build-system signals describe the selected inputs and cannot change this choice.
discoveryContract.inventory: project_files reports selection=automatic-project-text, the exclusion revision and counts of excluded entries, oversized files and binary content. The absence of a README, a recognized language or a project-specific eval suite has no bearing on indexability.

states.empty: The automatic inventory selected no eligible text after path, safety and resource checks.
states.source-only: At least one eligible text file is selected and none belong to the document projection. A lone package.json, build.gradle.kts or unfamiliar text file can satisfy this state.
states.documented: The selected inventory includes documentation. Documents can coexist with any other eligible text.

bootstrapProfiles.evidence: Java source plus optional Maven and Gradle root metadata
Kotlin source plus optional Maven, Gradle, and Kotlin DSL root metadata
TypeScript and JavaScript source, bounded CSS/SCSS and HTML/HTM text, plus optional package and compiler metadata
C, C++, Objective-C and Objective-C++ source plus optional CMake and Make metadata
C# source, bounded Razor/CSHTML, CSS/SCSS and HTML/HTM text, plus optional .NET root metadata
Retool apps, resources, workflows, RSX, payloads, bindings, and workflow edges

Automatic bounded text selection throughout the project. Known formats may contribute structured records and other text contributes lexical evidence. No extension or conventional source folder is required.
Explicit standalone Core documentation fixture including README, AGENTS and documentation trees.

webSourceText.discovery: Web-only and mixed folders select generic-source. The web_files counter includes these recognized formats even though other eligible text is also admitted.
webSourceText.retrieval: Native source candidates and Observer queries use existing bounded-text-fallback chunks with exact byte, line and hash bindings.
webSourceText.scope: Automatic source_scope reports roots [.], an empty extensions list and the actual file limits. Empty extensions means there is no extension allowlist. Bounded results and omissions still apply.
webSourceText.safety: Source exclusions, file/query/chunk budgets, secret quarantine, freshness and snapshot-bound reads remain required. Permanent consumer profiles are not rewritten.

profileContract.automaticProjectFiles: Kit-owned generic-source selects eligible text and documents from the same ProjectFiles inventory. Project .gitignore files and optional root .shinignore overrides determine eligible paths. Other explicit standalone profiles can retain their own source selectors.
profileContract.rootFiles: Required project-specific entry files; may be empty when other inputs are configured.
profileContract.includeRootWikiPages: A root Home.md and its sibling pages, including _Sidebar.md and _Footer.md, support bare extensionless wiki links such as Rotation#handover to the selected Rotation.md. Missing pages keep their broken-link diagnostic and symlinks are excluded. Managed discovery also selects eligible Markdown outside root wikis. In standalone generic-docs, includeRootWikiPages activates sibling page collection alongside explicit entries.
profileContract.optionalRootFiles: Conventional root metadata included only when present; missing candidates are not errors.
profileContract.sourceFactRoots: May independently back a fact-only index without source documents; missing conventional roots are informational for bootstrapOnly profiles while permanent profiles retain strict warnings.
profileContract.bootstrapOnly: Marks a generic discovery profile that intentionally has no project-specific golden eval cases.
profileContract.strictProfileCheck: Bootstrap profiles pass strict profile-check with an informational bootstrap-profile-without-eval issue.
profileContract.bootstrapLinkPolicy: bootstrapOnly profiles publish broken local links as diagnostics so an imperfect unfamiliar repository remains retrievable; permanent profiles reject the same candidate snapshot.
profileContract.doctorPolicy: Bootstrap uses non-strict doctor and requires zero errors while surfacing warnings. doctor --strict intentionally fails when diagnostic warnings remain and is mandatory after permanent adoption.
profileContract.evalBoundary: Do not run eval --strict for bootstrap-only profiles. Permanent adoption requires a consumer profile with golden evalCases.

safeTraversal.symlinkPolicy: Profile inputs, optional roots, source roots, agent start paths, recursive source files, and discovery signals fail closed or are skipped when the entry or any relative ancestor is a symlink; lexical parent traversal is rejected.
safeTraversal.caps: The kit bounds candidate file count and per-file bytes. Explicit standalone profile limits continue to apply to their own Core workflows.

agentWorkflow: The owner selects a folder and grants access through the intended agent settings. Project .gitignore files are honored and the owner may override them in the optional root .shinignore.
Discover authorized folders with shin_projects, verify the root with shin_status and ask a focused shin_query. Keep its snapshot for shin_inspect and shin_read.
Report exclusions, quarantine and resource limits when relevant. Preserve grant, safety, integrity and freshness refusals.
New kits rescan the already enrolled roots with their saved agent connections.

codexSkill.installer: Built shin-ce with its bundled instructions; set SHIN_CE to select that executable. Review the preview revision before applying it.
codexSkill.officialValidation: Codex skill-creator quick_validate.py passed against canonical and installed copies on M4.
codexSkill.implicitTrigger: Unknown, undocumented, source-only, newly created, or documentation-heavy repository before broad scanning.

promotionContract.scope: Explicit standalone Core adoption planning only. Managed projects are ready for retrieval after the service qualifies current evidence.

planner.authority: Lifecycle readiness only; adoption-check --strict remains the marker validator.

promotionRequirements: agentStartPaths when stable entry documents exist
project-local shin.project-adoption.v1 marker only when explicitly adopted

adoptionPrecedence.rule: Explicit standalone adoption planning may resolve a project-local marker and validate its profile. Installed managed registration and automatic file discovery ignore legacy marker selection.

hermeticEvidence.partialLayoutEvidence: A Retool repository containing apps without resources or workflows passes strict profile bootstrap and reports missing conventional roots as informational.
hermeticEvidence.imperfectDocumentationEvidence: A bootstrap docs corpus with a broken local link publishes a current diagnostic snapshot, passes non-strict doctor with zero errors, fails strict doctor on the warning, and remains queryable with --require-current.
hermeticEvidence.localServiceDocumentationPolicy: Local bootstrap qualification accepts only a link-only strict doctor or vacuum failure when errors, other warnings, generated drift and unfinished changes are absent. Strict Core audit results and explicit permanent-profile gates remain unchanged. Service status exposes a bounded documentation_warnings count; Monitor and TUI explain the warning while serving verified context and clear it after a qualified correction.

nonGoals: No complete language grammar or standard-library model.
No type checking, compilation, runtime execution, or complete call graph.
No automatic documentation generation or consumer mutation during bootstrap.
No claim of project-specific retrieval quality until a promoted profile defines evalCases.
